key.label: no printed key-signature accidentals
key.evidence: No key-signature accidentals are printed. The evidence box is the page 1 system 1 opening, where treble and bass clefs are followed directly by 3/4 and the lower staff then changes to treble; that box contains no signature accidentals. Systems 2 and 3 reprint clefs and no signature accidentals. Sharps beside the final lower-staff chord of P001 are local accidentals. No key-signature change is printed, and mode is not inferred.

opening_bar.evidence: P001 runs from the barline at x 278 to the barline at x 527. The printed clefs and 3/4 occupy its left side. The remaining width matches the following bars of system 1. The region is a complete 3/4 bar, not a short pickup.

terminal_bar.evidence: P024 runs from the barline at x 1455 to the thin stroke of the final barline at x 1626. Its width matches P018-P023. It is a complete 3/4 bar, not a shortened complement.

pickup_plus_terminal_vs_meter.note: There is no incomplete pickup and no terminal partial. Both end bars are complete 3/4 bars of capacity 3. Their sum is not compared as a pickup complement, because neither bar is short.
pickup_plus_terminal_vs_meter.exception_evidence: Page 1 system 1, P001, x 278 to x 527, is full once the printed clefs and 3/4 are allowed for. Page 1 system 3, P024, x 1455 to x 1626, matches the neighboring bars and ends at the final thin-thick barline.

repeats.evidence: Backward repeat closing P008 on the thin-thick barline. Two repeat dots stand in the central spaces of each staff, immediately left of the thin stroke at x 1626. Upper-staff dots sit near x 1618-1624, y 250-255 and y 262-265. Lower-staff dots sit near x 1618-1624, y 373-379 and y 385-389. The thick stroke follows at x 1631-1639. The locked boundary stays x 1626. No dots stand to the right of the thick stroke.

Forward repeat opening P009. Thick stroke x 213-221, thin stroke x 224-225, and two repeat dots to the right of the thin stroke in the central spaces of each staff. Upper-staff dots sit near x 230-236, y 560-565 and y 572-577. Lower-staff dots sit near x 230-238, y 694-700 and y 706-711. No dots stand on the left of the thick stroke. The repeated section opens at P009.

Final barline and backward repeat closing P024. Two repeat dots stand in the central spaces of each staff, immediately left of the thin stroke at x 1626. Upper-staff dots sit near x 1618-1624, y 877-882 and y 889-895. Lower-staff dots sit near x 1618-1624, y 1003-1008 and y 1015-1020. The thick stroke follows at x 1631-1638. The locked boundary stays x 1626.

section_double_bars.evidence: Thin stroke x 1626 and thick stroke x 1631-1639 close P008. Two repeat dots stand in the central spaces of each staff immediately left of the thin stroke. This thin-thick barline is the backward repeat recorded above.

final_barline.evidence: Thin stroke x 1626 and thick stroke x 1631-1638 close P024. Two repeat dots stand in the central spaces of each staff immediately left of the thin stroke. This is the final barline and a backward repeat.

clef_changes.evidence: Lower staff of P001 prints a treble clef after the opening bass clef and the 3/4, before the first left-hand note. Centre near page x 383, y 389. That treble governs the first left-hand note of P001.

Lower staff of P008 prints a cautionary bass clef immediately before the backward repeat. Centre near page x 1598, y 392. The notes of P008 stay in treble. Bass takes effect at the first left-hand note of P009.

clef_change_check: The upper staff opens in treble and stays in treble; systems 2 and 3 reprint it. The lower staff opens in bass. Two later lower-staff clef changes are printed: a treble clef in P001 after the 3/4, and a cautionary bass clef at the end of P008 that takes effect at P009. Systems 2 and 3 reprint that bass clef; those reprints are not further changes. No other clef glyph is printed.
